This Privacy Policy applies to the websites on which it is posted, which are operated by (“Company,” “we,” or us”). This Policy also applies when you respond to our emails, place orders via mail, fax or phone, or otherwise contact us. We refer to each of these websites, services, and offerings as a “Site,” and collectively as the “Sites.” This Policy discloses our practices with respect to the collection of information through the Sites and our use of the information. This Policy applies solely to information collected through the Sites. This Policy does not apply to third-party websites, applications, and services, even if they are linked to or accessible from our Sites. By using the Sites, you agree with the terms of this Policy. If you do not agree with any term in this Policy, please do not use the Sites or provide any information to us.

1. Collection of Information From and About You.
We collect certain categories of personal information from and about you, depending on how you interact with us.
. We collect your name, address, telephone number, and email address through a Site when you voluntarily submit it. On some Sites, we may also collect a username if you create one.
We collect Contact Information

We collect your order history, including the products you purchased or browsed through our Site. We collect information about your product or shopping preferences. We also collect billing information, including your credit card information and billing address.
We collect Purchase and Payment Information
. We collect information such as your age, gender, and birthdate.

. When you connect to a Site, there is certain technical information that may be collected through the use of cookies and other tracking tools. This information includes your IP address, operating system, device identifiers, browser type, settings, information about your Internet connection, and the number, duration, and character of page visits. We collect information about users over time and across different websites when you use the Site. For example, we may look at what site you came from, or what site you visit when you leave us. We also look at how you engage with our emails, including whether you open them or click on links. Third parties help us collect personal information this way. This information helps us update a Site so that it stays interesting to our visitors and includes content that is tailored to visitors’ interests. You can set your computer browser to disable cookies. If you disable cookies, certain features on the Site may not work. Learn more about the types of cookies and specific tools we use, and how you can control them, in Section 5 and in our .

3. Use of Your information
We use each of the categories of personal information described above as permitted by law and for the purposes listed below:

. We use your information to make our Sites available, present content on them, and keep them functional. We use your information to fulfill purchases you make on our Sites. We also use your information to provide you with access to certain areas and features on a Site – for example, if you create an account on our Site or to integrate with third party social media platforms.
To provide you with products and services and fulfill orders

We use your information to respond to your questions, comments, and requests. We will communicate with you about your activities on a Site, including your purchases and your account. We communicate with you about our relationship or your feedback. We may also contact you about this Privacy Policy or our website Terms.
To communicate with you.

We use your information to analyze how our Sites are used and whether visitors are interacting with or interested in certain features or areas. We also measure and monitor visitor traffic to evaluate how the Sites perform. We use cookies and other common tracking tools for this kind of analysis, as well as to recognize returning visitors, to store your password if you register, and customize or personalize our Site for you. We use information this way to understand how visitors use our Sites, to make our Sites and products better, to make updates, and to customize your experience with us.
To evaluate, personalize, and improve our Sites.

. If another entity acquires Company, Ferrero, or all or any part of our assets or business, information that we have collected about the users of the Sites may be transferred to such entity. We may transfer information this way if we merge, consolidate, reorganize, acquire, or form a joint venture with another business. Information may be among the assets transferred to a prospective buyer, new owner, or other third party involved. Also, if any bankruptcy or reorganization proceeding is brought by or against us, personal information may be considered an asset of ours and may be sold or transferred to third parties.

. To stop receiving our marketing emails, visit the Ferrero Preference Center or follow the unsubscribe instructions in the footer of any marketing message you get from us. Even if you opt out of receiving marketing messages, we will still send you transactional messages. These include responses to your questions and communications about your orders.
You can opt out of our marketing emails

. You have choices with respect to our text messages. We may provide certain automated, recurring text message-based services (the “Text Services”). You can opt in to the Text Services by giving us your phone number on certain Sites. Your consent is not required and is not a condition of any purchase. If you opt in to Text Services, we may send automated, recurring marketing text messages from and about Company to the mobile number you provided, such as announcements, offerings, promotions, discounts, abandoned cart reminders, alerts, and administrative messages. Message frequency may vary, and standard message and data rates may apply. You can opt out of our text messages by replying “STOP” (a confirmation message will be sent). You can also text “HELP” for help. Data obtained from you in connection with the Text Services may include your mobile phone number with your mobile carrier’s name, your opt-in / opt-out status, and the date, time, and content of your messages to us (“Mobile Information”). For purposes of our Text Services, we use and share your Mobile Information just to send text messages from and about Company. Your Opt-in Information will not be sold or shared with third parties for their promotional or marketing purposes purposes.

6. Your California Privacy Rights
7. Links to Other Sites.

A Site may contain links to other websites that are not owned, operated, or maintained by us. You should note when you leave a Site and read the terms and conditions and privacy policies of each and every website that you visit. You should also independently assess the authenticity of any website which appears or claims that it is one of our Sites (including those linked to through an email). Despite any links that might exist on a Site, unless expressly stated otherwise, we do not control, recommend, or endorse and are not affiliated with these websites or their content, products, services, or privacy policies. Downloading material from certain websites may risk infringing intellectual property rights or introducing viruses into your computer system.
7. Links to Other Sites.
8. Protection of Children’s Privacy.

These Sites are not intended for children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from any person under the age of sixteen (16). We do not have actual knowledge that we sell or share personal information of consumers under 16 years of age.

We use standard security measures, but the Internet is not 100% secure. We cannot promise that your use of our Sites will be completely safe. We encourage you to use caution when using the Internet. This includes not sharing your passwords. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim all liability and responsibility for any damages (including, but not limited to, any and all direct, special, indirect, consequential, or punitive loss or other damages of any kind, whether in contract (including fundamental breach), tort (including negligence), or otherwise) that you may suffer due to any loss, unauthorized access, misuse, or alteration of any information you submit to a Site.

10. Retention Period.

We will retain information for as long as it is reasonably needed or permitted in light of the purposes for which we collected it. We also retain information as required by law. The criteria we use to determine our retention policies include the length of our relationship with you, your requests, your continued use of our Sites, ongoing obligations such as contracts and services, and our legal obligations.

The information set forth on the Sites concerning any products or services is applicable only in the United States, and these products and services may not be available in all locations. If you are located outside of the United States, you are solely responsible for compliance with any applicable local laws, which may not afford the same level of protection as those in your country.
